metadata.scenario: A patient calls to complain that the physical therapist rushed through yesterday's session in 25 minutes instead of the full 45 minutes. She says she's paying for a full session and expects the full time. She wants a credit or a makeup session.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Patricia Wilson. I'm calling about my mother’s physical therapy session yesterday. Hello, Patricia! I'm sorry to hear that. What seems to be the issue? Well, the physical therapist rushed through the session in just 25 minutes instead of the full 45. I understand how frustrating that must be, especially since you’re paying for a full session. Exactly! I expect to get what I paid for. I want a credit or a makeup session. I can certainly assist with that. May I ask who your mother’s physical therapist was? It was Dr. James Rodriguez. Thank you for that information. I’ll need to review the session notes and speak with Dr. Rodriguez. I just want to make sure this gets addressed, as my mother really needs her therapy. Absolutely, Patricia. I will prioritize this for you. Thank you. Will you follow up with me about it? Yes, I’ll personally follow up with you once I have more details. Alright, I appreciate that. Additionally, since your mother will need ongoing support after her hip replacement, we can also schedule some post-surgery recovery care if you're interested. That would be great. Can you tell me more about that? Certainly! Our post-surgery recovery care is $85 to $110 for 1 to 3 hours. It includes specialized care to help with her recovery process. Okay, I’d like to get more information about scheduling that once we sort this issue out. Absolutely! I’ll make a note to discuss scheduling once we have addressed the therapy session. Thank you so much for your help, Margaret. You're welcome, Patricia. I’ll be in touch soon with updates regarding Dr. Rodriguez. Sounds good. Have a great day! You too, take care!
